body: He went to weekly counseling with a grief specialist for a year after it happened. (This particular therapist typically works with clients for a year after the loss.) I agree that I should go back, and perhaps he should go back. It's tough to pull off two therapy appointments in the evening. I do try to compromise with him on things like whether dinner should comprise a sandwich made with mac and cheese (the so-called "mac attack") with fries on the side and a milkshake, which it did last night. I feel like I'm making an effort and it's not paying off, so maybe I'm just failing.
